body: The Arnold Van is our fully equipped, all season, off grid Ford Transit build designed for long term travel and true independence. With 800Ah lithium power, solar charging, heated water systems, induction cooking, air conditioning, and upgraded suspension, this van is built to handle four season conditions while delivering the comfort of a small cabin. It balances refined finishes with durable components so you can travel farther and stay longer without compromise.

• 400W solar system• 50A DC to DC battery charger• 800Ah SOK lithium battery bank• 3000W pure sine inverter and charger• Four 110V outlets with USB A and C• GFCI protected outlet system• 30A shore power hookup

• 33 gallon freshwater tank with level sensor and heating pad• Heated greywater system• Indoor shower with white FRP walls and right side drain• 4 gallon electric hot water heater• Separett Tiny composting toilet ready with exterior vent• No exterior shower

• Premium Havelock wool insulation throughout• Insulated and heated plumbing lines and tanks• Maxxair Deluxe roof vent fan with remote• 12V roof mounted Nomadic air conditioner• Gasoline powered Espar cabin heater
• Acacia butcher block countertop with pop up extension• Double burner induction cooktop• Undermount stainless sink with hot and cold faucet• Isotherm Cruise 130 fridge with freezer• 700W microwave
• Stained wood ceiling• Vinyl wood style flooring• Recessed dimmable LED ceiling lights• Dual reading lights• LED accent lighting under cabinets and in garage• Dedicated shower light

• Four overhead cabinets• Under counter double door cabinet• Drawer and storage combo cabinet• Floor to ceiling closet with shelves and hanging space• Bed step drawer under fridge• Bench seat with pull out dog bed and storage• CNC spice rack• Dual heavy duty pull out trays• Transit headliner shelf
• Queen memory foam bed• Swivel driver and passenger seats• Lagun adjustable table• Fire extinguisher and CO and smoke detector• Full bug net and blackout window cover set

• RB Components bunk window• Sliding door window• Rear glass windows with added insulation• Paint matched body flares• Electric awning with integrated LED lighting• Exterior perimeter lighting and 50 inch light bar

• FVCO roof rack with ladder• FVCO rear door platform• FVCO ski and snowboard locker• All terrain wheels and tires with Method 703 rims• Van Compass Stage 3 suspension with adjustable shocks• Side steps

• Addington Acacia flooring• Natural wood stain on ceiling and counters• Bee colored cabinet doors• Stainless fixtures• White outlets• Leather and stainless hardware• Canvas Heather Beige Sunbrella cushions
